_meta.design: Pre-registered. EVERY coefficient is either (a) directly cited to a published FDA statistic, or (b) arithmetically derived from cited statistics. Nothing is a judgment magnitude. Modifiers for which no published rate exists (post-CRL resubmission success, gene/cell-specific rates, AdCom->extension effect, breakthrough causal effect) were INTENTIONALLY OMITTED rather than guessed — see _meta.omitted. Coefficients are set before any residual against the 33 Polymarket markets is computed; audit.py §12 asserts the freeze and the leakage-safety.
_meta.form: logit(p_ever) = base + sum(applicable approval_modifiers_logodds);  p_on_time = 1 - extension_rate;  fair = p_ever * p_on_time (dated markets); abstains (N/A) on open-ended year markets.

omitted.prior_crl_refile: No published post-CRL resubmission approval rate exists (FDA does not report it; Class 2 resubmission goals are timelines, not approval rates). Omitted rather than guessed. The refile signal is handled separately in the validity layer from the real market data (prior_crl axis), not modeled here.
omitted.breakthrough_fasttrack: Published evidence attributes higher approval rates of expedited drugs to selection bias, not a causal effect; no defensible causal magnitude. Omitted.
omitted.modality_505b2: No published 505(b)(2)-specific first-cycle approval rate found. Omitted.
omitted.adcom_extension: No published AdCom->PDUFA-extension rate found. Omitted.

base_first_cycle_approval.note: CDER first-cycle approval of novel drugs = 46/55 (84%) in 2023; 39/46 (85%) in 2017. Base = P(first action is an approval). DIRECTLY CITED.

priority_review.note: Set to 0 on approval probability: published evidence attributes priority review's higher observed approval rate to selection bias, not causation. Real effect is on the review CLOCK (6 vs 10 months), not approval odds. CITED (as a null).

modality_novel_mechanism.note: DERIVED, not guessed: logit(0.64) - logit(0.84) = -1.0828, from the FDA First-Cycle Review evaluation (novel mechanism of action 64% first-cycle approval vs 84% overall). Applied to gene/cell therapies as a documented proxy for 'novel mechanism' (gene/cell is a subset of novel-MoA). CI from the 0.55-0.72 band on the 64% figure.

extension_rate.note: P(first action slips past the PDUFA goal date). FDA meets 92-96% of goal dates under PDUFA VII -> 4-8% slip; midpoint 6%. DIRECTLY CITED.
